title: Rollback schema expansion
trigger_conditions: Verification fails or rollout safety threshold is breached.
rollback_operations: Stop new writers before reversing schema artifacts; prefer retaining additive nullable columns.
data_preservation: Do not delete committed approval or outbox data; preserve additive columns for forensic recovery.

title: Disable repository conflict resolution
trigger_conditions: Verification fails or rollout safety threshold is breached.
rollback_operations: Restore the prior repository path while retaining idempotency columns.
data_preservation: Do not delete committed approval or outbox data; preserve additive columns for forensic recovery.

title: Disable service idempotency path
trigger_conditions: Verification fails or rollout safety threshold is breached.
rollback_operations: Route service calls to the prior approved behavior only after confirming compatibility impact.
data_preservation: Do not delete committed approval or outbox data; preserve additive columns for forensic recovery.

title: Stop and reverse safe backfill
trigger_conditions: Verification fails or rollout safety threshold is breached.
rollback_operations: Stop backfill; restore only values written by the current backfill run from its audit table.
data_preservation: Do not delete committed approval or outbox data; preserve additive columns for forensic recovery.

title: Remove strict constraint enforcement
trigger_conditions: Verification fails or rollout safety threshold is breached.
rollback_operations: Stop strict-enforcement writers, remove or disable the new constraint, retain columns and forensic data.
data_preservation: Do not delete committed approval or outbox data; preserve additive columns for forensic recovery.
irreversible_effects: External consumers may already rely on strict single-event behavior.

title: Disable new observability signals
trigger_conditions: Verification fails or rollout safety threshold is breached.
rollback_operations: Disable new metric and log emission configuration without changing business behavior.
data_preservation: Do not delete committed approval or outbox data; preserve additive columns for forensic recovery.

title: Rollback progressive deployment
trigger_conditions: Verification fails or rollout safety threshold is breached.
rollback_operations: Halt rollout and restore the last verified application version; retain expansion schema.
data_preservation: Do not delete committed approval or outbox data; preserve additive columns for forensic recovery.
